title: Latency-of-Refusal Metric: When in a Trajectory Do Agents Stop?

original_idea.body: # Latency-of-Refusal Metric: When in a Trajectory Do Agents Stop?

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: pre-refusal irreversible actions are real harm; refusal-latency reframes a binary metric meaningfully.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: instrument existing harmful-task trajectories to record first-refusal step; standard analysis.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: refusal-latency + pre-refusal-damage metric across models.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: public benchmarks, training-free, unmeasured property.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference over multi-step tasks + log analysis; light.

novelty.reasoning: Refusal scored binary; latency metric may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A refusal-latency / pre-refusal-damage metric likely not formalized.
